entities.description: A close-up shot of an elderly man with short, thinning gray hair and visible age spots on his skin, wearing a plain gray t-shirt. He is seated and leaning forward with his head bowed, covering his eyes and upper face with both hands in a gesture of distress or exhaustion.

skin.features: wrinkled, age spots, veins visible on forearms

pose.hands: covering face, fingers spread over eyes
